TaskDescription: In 36 trials an incomplete geometric figure arranged as a 3 x 3 matrix was presented, with the lower-right corner always missing. Participants had to select the correct missing element from eight alternatives to complete the matrix. The presented elements follow one or more underlying patterns; recognizing these patterns allows the correct piece to be identified. Performance is measured as the proportion of matrices solved correctly.
Instructions: Due to copyright restrictions the full instructions cannot be reproduced here. Participants were shown a sample matrix and were guided through the solution strategy using that example. The Advanced Progressive Matrices (APM) were administered as a power test without time limits. Matrices were presented in order of increasing difficulty.

Session.Description: Sequential numbering of the sessions. Usually 1, only larger than 1 when task had to be restarted.

Block.Description: Sequential numbering of the blocks. Items were presented within three block.Participants could take breaks on their own discretion between blocks.

TrialNum.Description: Sequential numbering of the trials within each block.

ItemNumber.Description: Item identifier corresponding to the position of the matrix within the Advanced Progressive Matrices.

DifficultyItem.Description: Level of difficulty assigned to the current matrix, according to the test manual.

MaxRT.Description: The maximally allowed response time was 1000 s

FIX.Description: Duration (seconds) that the fixation cross was presented at the start of each trial. The duration was drawn from a uniform distribution between 1.0 and 1.5 s.

ISI.Description: Always zero as there was no ISI

ITI.Description: Duration (seconds) between the end of the current trial (after the response period) and the onset of the next trial. The ITI was drawn from a uniform distribution between 1.0 and 1.5 s.

Accuracy.Description: 1 = participant responded correctly; 0 = participant responded incorrectly. There are no trials without a response.

RT.Description: Time (in seconds) from probe onset (3x3 matrix and response alternatives) to the participant's mouse click.

Response.Description: The missing element selected by the participant in the current trial via mouse click. Participants could choose one of the eight alternatives (1–8) or select “I do not know” (coded as 0).

CorrResp.Description: The correct missing element for the 3 x 3 matrix, selected from eight alternatives (1–8). Defined by the experimental design and the test manual.

Odd_Even.Description: 1 = odd trial number; 2 = even trial number.

RTms.Description: Time (in milliseconds) from probe onset (3x3 matrix and response alternatives) to the participant's mouse click.

PropCorr.Description: The proportion of correctly solved items.
